mapping_note: Twenty reference encounters are listed. The executable pack deliberately consolidates adjacent beats into nine local-play scenes; repeated implemented_ids identify those consolidations rather than claiming that every reference beat has its own executable scene. Generated routes use six core scenes and one or both optional vignettes.

prerequisites: Jules and Mara are together on the path
actions: notice the toy boat stuck beside reeds
promise not to enter the pond
consequences: the need to retrieve the boat is established
both children remain on the bank
prose_obligations: show ordinary concern, not recklessness
make the boat’s position legible
scenes.consolidation: Combined with the safety promise in spot_boat; no separate scene is executed.

prerequisites: the boat has been noticed
actions: Jules explains the boat’s family history
consequences: his attachment is understood
prose_obligations: give Jules a distinct voice
make the boat more than a generic prize

prerequisites: the boat has been noticed
actions: Mara chooses to help without showing off
consequences: her motive frames the safe approach
prose_obligations: make helpfulness different from daring
scenes.consolidation: Mara’s want is stated inside the inciting scene rather than emitted as a separate episode.

prerequisites: the children have asked for help
actions: ask the keeper to lend the net
consequences: the net is borrowed with permission
prose_obligations: show a trustworthy adult and a plain request
scenes.consolidation: The keeper’s response is one local action in borrow_net.

prerequisites: the keeper lends the net
actions: check the hoop and mesh
consequences: the condition of the tool is known before use
prose_obligations: make the net long-handled and useful
scenes.consolidation: Lending and inspection share one scene; the inspection remains a separately traced atomic action.

prerequisites: the net is borrowed
actions: explain not to wade or yank a snagged net
consequences: later careful actions have an ordinary reason
prose_obligations: avoid legalistic recitation
scenes.consolidation: The warning is dialog within borrow_net, not an extra offstage effect.

prerequisites: the net is checked
actions: mark a stable edge and assign positions
consequences: Mara kneels; Jules stays behind the line
prose_obligations: keep both children on the bank

prerequisites: the children have marked the edge
actions: both children agree to stay on the bank
consequences: unsafe reaching is not an available action
prose_obligations: make the choice human and brief
scenes.consolidation: The agreement is the second atomic action in the bank setup scene.

prerequisites: the boat is visible
actions: inspect reeds or confirm a clear sightline
consequences: a visible gap can enable a safer cast through weeds
prose_obligations: make observation useful without making it mandatory in every route

prerequisites: the bank setup is complete
the wind is breezy
actions: wait for a lull before casting
consequences: a safe opening is used rather than casting into a gust
prose_obligations: show patience as an action
scenes.consolidation: The lull is an atomic action within cast_net when the embedded wind is breezy.

prerequisites: the net is checked and the bank setup is ready
actions: lower the hoop from the bank
consequences: reach, wind, mesh and reeds determine the result
prose_obligations: state the physical outcome in the scene
scenes.consolidation: The cast and its result are one executable mini-play, not a hidden transition.

prerequisites: the cast reaches an unobserved reed fringe
actions: stop pulling and ease the net free
consequences: the boat remains in the pond; the borrowed net stays intact
prose_obligations: let a small failure change the next choice
scenes.consolidation: This outcome is one branch within cast_net; it is not guaranteed in clear water or after the gap is observed.

prerequisites: the borrowed mesh is torn
actions: test the hoop and draw it back when the toy slips through
consequences: the boat is not retrieved and the net is not repeatedly abused
prose_obligations: make the mesh parameter physically relevant
scenes.consolidation: The torn-mesh alternative shares cast_net with other mutually exclusive outcomes.

prerequisites: the safe reach is shorter than the boat distance
actions: compare reach from the dry path and stop
consequences: the boat stays in the pond without either child leaning in
prose_obligations: make the refusal to overreach earned
scenes.consolidation: Recorded as a local measurement outcome, not an omitted scene effect.

prerequisites: the pond is gusty
actions: observe the gust and hold back
consequences: no cast is made into unsafe, shifting water
prose_obligations: let wind affect possibility without inventing danger beyond the setting
scenes.consolidation: A branch of cast_net; calm and breezy runs have different actions.

prerequisites: the water offers a clear line or an observed reed gap
actions: angle the hoop and lower it carefully
consequences: a sound net can hold the boat
prose_obligations: show a choice informed by observation
scenes.consolidation: Approach choice, catch and lift are atomic actions in one short local play.

prerequisites: the boat is held in an intact net
actions: raise the handle slowly from the bank
consequences: the usable boat reaches dry ground
prose_obligations: do not let either child reach into the water
scenes.consolidation: The lift is the concluding action of the successful cast_net mini-play.

prerequisites: the attempt is finished and the net is out of the pond
actions: tell the keeper what happened and return the tool
consequences: the keeper regains a useful net
prose_obligations: return usefulness as well as custody

prerequisites: the boat has reached the bank and the net is returned
actions: hand the boat back to Jules
consequences: Jules has a usable boat; the friendship is affirmed
prose_obligations: complete the race plan as an earned immediate payoff

prerequisites: the boat remains beyond safe reach and the net is returned
actions: draw the boat together instead of entering the pond
consequences: the toy is lost for now, but the children finish together and safely
prose_obligations: allow disappointment and emotional closure without an unanswered future plan
